subject: general
question: The average of the two numbers is 48. If 3 is added to a smaller number, then the ratio between them is 11 ∶ 20. Find the larger number. (Round up to two decimal places).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of the two numbers = 48 × 2 = 96.

New sum after adding 3 to the smaller number = 96 + 3 = 99.

Ratio of (Smaller + 3) : (Larger) = 11 : 20.

Total ratio parts = 11 + 20 = 31 units.

Larger number = (20 ÷ 31) × 99 = 1980 ÷ 31 ≈ 63.87.

**∴ The correct answer is 63.87.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Average of x and y = 48 | Ratio (x + 3) : y = 11 : 20.

Formula Used: Average = Sum of observations ÷ Total observations.

 
 
 11 parts
 20 parts
 (x + 3)
 Larger (y)
 
• 
 Total = 99 (31 parts)
 Larger No. = (20 / 31) × 99

⇒ Sum (x + y) = 48 × 2 = 96

⇒ According to the second condition: (x + 3) ÷ y = 11 ÷ 20

⇒ 20(x + 3) = 11y

⇒ 20x + 60 = 11y

⇒ Substitute x = 96 − y from the sum equation:

⇒ 20(96 − y) + 60 = 11y

⇒ 1920 − 20y + 60 = 11y

⇒ 1980 = 31y

⇒ y = 1980 ÷ 31

⇒ y ≈ 63.8709

**∴ The correct answer is 63.87.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Properties

If each of the n numbers is increased by a constant k, then the average of the n numbers also increases by k.

Ratio Division

To divide a quantity S into two parts in the ratio a : b, the first part is (a ÷ (a + b)) × S and the second part is (b ÷ (a + b)) × S.

Weighted Average

Weighted Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where A is the average and n is the frequency.</p
